title: Aesthetic Critique: Principles of Aesthetics
description: The painter Depierris seems to be very unhappy...

dialogs.text: Traveler! You've come at just the right time! I just found a wondrous photo-taking spot — all I need is a little help from you!
Still looking for inspiration, are you?
Of course. This is far from enough materials — a single photo will not allow me to create a full picture.
I usually need several dozen pictures — sometimes even a hundred — for use as reference material.
That many, huh...
As I've told you before, the focus of painting is "creation."
If you simply impress the things you see upon the canvas as-is, that is not "painting" — that is "photography."
What a painter must truly do is to use their sensitivity and aesthetic sense to observe the world around them, before curating, transforming, and editing it...
Until such a time as the most beautiful aspect of every object can be abstracted and then engraved upon the canvas to complete one painting.
Well, that was as clear as mud.
You... Alright. Basically, I'll only use the prettiest parts of these pictures as reference.
For example, the light-shadow balance here is excellent, but the scenery is lacking by contrast — as such, I will only refer to its use of the former.
The other picture contains a traveler in a most fascinating pose, and the next features a most magnificent building...
It is almost like playing with a puzzle in your mind, with the beauty or beastliness of the final product depending solely on your aesthetics and understanding.
This is not a rigorous way of putting things, since we can also change or abstract the sights within the reference material themselves... but that's all you need to understand.
So you still need my help, please and thank me.
Uh... Right, yes, that's right! Your photo-taking skills are incredible — indeed, my friends have wanted to come see you in person after witnessing your work.
I'm sure that with your help, I'll be able to create something truly extraordinary.
So please, for the sake of human aesthetics — and for the Mora I've prepared — please help me!
So I'll have to continue gathering material for you, or something.
Speak more simply!
Do the pictures have different uses?
Aesthetics — aesthetics are the key!
This... This isn't good...
What photo do you need taken this time?
This time... Well, there's no need to take any photos. Actually, I have another favor to ask of you.
Ahem, this is quite embarrassing, but, ah... Could you help me find something to eat... Garlic Baguette, for example?
You... didn't bring anything to eat?
No! I brought a lot of bread, along with some jam and jerky. That should've been enough for the day...
But I put the foodstuffs aside to focus on the painting, and I soon got engrossed... By the time I realized that I was hungry, they were gone.
Maybe some animal or hungry passerby made off with it on the sly — in which case, I do hope it fills their tummies.
Unfortunately, mine shall have to be filled some other way... And I cannot return to the city now — not without having gathered enough material.
Wait just a moment, then.
I'll be counting on you, then. You can get some in the city.
Haha... Ooh, I feel a little weak. Is it the hunger? Or have I just been thinking too much...
I'll get you what you need.
Did you... run out of Mora to buy food?
Where to this time?
It lacks tension... What's going on?
I feel like we're missing something... decisive...
Taking photos, are we?
That's right — this Kamera is the engine of inspiration for my paintings.
My name is Depierris, and I am a painter — most pleased to meet you, most pleased indeed!
Uh... huh. Likewise...?
Now, I would normally treat a newfound friend to a coffee, but alas, there is no café to be found nearby.
Hmm. Well, why don't you take this Fonta — let us have a toast, and we'll consider ourselves formally acquainted! Have you been to Fontaine before, by the way?
I'm a first-time visitor.
Ah, then you're in for a good time! Head into the city and see the sights — like the waterways stretching out overhead!
Then you can head out into the streets and see the intricate machines, even if not all of them have aesthetic value — well, in the opinion of this humble painter, anyway.
And finally, you can sit yourself down at a café and appreciate a cup of coffee.
Who knows, perhaps someone will come to chat you up while you do so!
Still, if the person who comes up to you claims to be from some sort of "Kamera Club"...
Then be on your guard for their words of folly... There are those amongst them who are engaged in it, in any case.
And what are these elements doing exactly?
What, you ask? No less than set cultural life in our grand Fontaine on the path to annihilation!
Now, this is no mere fearmongering. Can you guess what they speak of in this club?
"If we speak only of pictures, then those taken by Kameras are far superior to paintings."
I mean, just listen to that "if we speak only of pictures" nonsense — and it is but nonsense, no matter how loudly they proclaim it to be the truth!
If we simply present images as they are, where would the space be for aesthetics?
Well, it is true that some of us are indeed figuring out how to draw even better naturalistic work... But even that is rooted in their aesthetic sense.
Aesthetics! Aesthetics are the key — do you understand?
N—Not really...
The observation of the world through the artist's eyes is merely the first step. We must explore sensibility and beauty through the brush to bring a masterpiece forth from the heart.
Not all those who love Kameras are brutish imbeciles bereft of all artistic sense, of course.
I have many friends who love Kameras, and I love speaking to them. At times, their photos inspire me, and my paintings inspire them in turn.
Those who know nothing of art and only know how to blow their own trumpets... Oh, how they make my blood boil!
They disgrace those who love photography and painting alike! They truly are... *cough*... *cough*
Calm down, get some water...
Ah, thank you... I cannot prevent my rage from boiling over every time I speak of this matter.
As such, I, along with some friends, have decided to use this Kamera to take pictures that may be used as material with which to create a series of paintings.
Afterward, we will place these paintings alongside the pictures used to create them in an exhibition — and then, all shall see the difference between paintings and photography!
Yet, *sigh* I see little meaning in the various pictures I've taken. My friends tell me that the best sights may be found in the direst of lands.
Underwater, for example, or on cliffs, or perhaps the deep wood where few humans go... But I dare not go to such places alone.
And hiring adventurers may take too much time...
#Hmm... Dear {M#sir}{F#lady}, would you mind coming under an artist's employ?
As long as you don't make me do the painting...
No need to worry! We shall both simply do what we're good at.
You need not worry about the payment either. I often hire adventurers as guards on my inspiration-gathering trips, so I know the rules.
It's just that this matter was too urgent, and I could not hire anyone in time...
Well, that's settled, then. With your help, I grow ever more confident in my odds of producing good work.
I'm only really good at adventurer stuff.
S—Somewhat?
Will these... elements do anything to me?
Just as they have done for Fontaine — they will destroy the cultural life you should have shared in.
